svg.title: Nykaa Fit MVP, a product experiment. Headline: Will this fit? Personalised size guidance on the product page of a fashion shopping prototype, built to reduce uncertainty before you buy. It sizes your saved items across brands from your own measurements, and it is allowed to say it does not know. Live at nykaa-fit-mvp.vercel.app, start at /fit-profile. A measuring tape marked with the store chart sizes XS to XXL; a marker sweeps along it and settles at bust 35 inches, between S and M, the example profile used in this README. Numbers: 60 products in the mock catalogue, up to 3 measurements (bust, waist, hip), 0 network calls in the fit feature, 17 tracked events, 9 success metrics. Hypothesis: for shoppers already interested in a fashion product, uncertainty about fit can reduce purchase confidence and contribute to size related returns; personalised fit guidance may increase conversion while reducing size related returns. Nothing in this build demonstrates that it does. Not affiliated with Nykaa.

div.div: Nykaa Fit MVP · a product experiment

div.p: Personalised size guidance on the product page of a fashion store prototype. It sizes your saved items across brands from your own measurements, shows its working, and is allowed to say it does not know.

div.span: network calls in the fit feature

div.p: Uncertainty about fit can reduce purchase confidence and drive size related returns. Personalised fit guidance may lift conversion while cutting those returns. Nothing in this build demonstrates that it does.

section.div: Not affiliated with Nykaa. Brand names and size charts are mock data so the catalogue reads realistically.
